Lochia.6: Ngemva kokubeletha, i-lochia ibhekisela ekuphumeni kwamanzi esithandweni okuhlobene nenqubo yemvelo yokululama kwesibeletho. Umbala nenani lakho kushintsha kancane kancane ezinsukwini nasemavikini alandelayo.
Lochia.15: I-lochia ukuphuma kwamanzi esithandweni okuvela ngemva kokubeletha. Ikakhulukazi iwukukhishwa kancane kancane kwegazi, uketshezi nezicubu ezibelethweni lapho lilulama.
Lochia.16: Ihluke ekuyeni esikhathini okujwayelekile. Iyalindelwa ngesikhathi sangemva kokubeletha futhi ngokuvamile iyancipha kancane kancane.
Lochia.18: I-lochia ayisho ukuthi isikhathi sakho sesibuyile. Ukubuya kwesikhathi sakho kuyisenzakalo esihlukile esenzeka kamuva.
Lochia.20: Ukubukeka kwayo ngokuvamile kushintsha emasontweni ambalwa okuqala. Umbala uya ngokukhanya kancane kancane futhi inani liyancipha.
Lochia.25: Ukuphuma kwamanzi ngokuvamile kubomvu futhi kungaba kuningi ekuqaleni.
Lochia.28: Umbala uya ngokukhanya kancane kancane futhi ungaba pinki noma insundu.
Lochia.31: Ukuphuma kwamanzi ngokuvamile kuba lula, kuphuzi noma kumhlophe, ngaphambi kokuphela.
Lochia.33: Indlela i-lochia eguquka ngayo ayifani ncamashi kubo bonke. Ushintsho oluthile lungahambisana ngokwemvelo nokululama ngemva kokubeletha.
Lochia.35: Inani lingashintsha ezinsukwini ezimbalwa zokuqala bese lehla kancane kancane.
Lochia.37: I-lochia ngokuvamile isuka ebomvini iye emibalini ekhanyayo ngokuhamba kwesikhathi.
Lochia.39: Ingahlala amasonto amaningana, futhi indlela eguquka ngayo ihluka phakathi komuntu nomuntu.
Lochia.41: Ngalesi sikhathi, ukulandelela okulula kungakusiza ubheke ukuthi umzimba wakho uguquka kanjani ngaphandle kokuqhathanisa ulwazi lwakho nolomunye umuntu.
Lochia.43: Khetha ukugeza okuthambile, okuhlelekile ngaphandle kwemikhiqizo ebangela ukuhlukumeza.
Lochia.45: Ungabhala umbala, inani nenqubekela phambili yokuphuma kwamanzi uma lokho kukusiza ulandelele ukululama kwakho.
Lochia.47: Isikhathi sangemva kokubeletha sidinga isikhathi. Lalela umzimba wakho futhi uhloniphe isidingo sakho sokululama.
Lochia.49: I-lochia ivela ezinsukwini ezilandela ukubeletha futhi iyancipha kancane kancane. Ukubuya kwesikhathi sakho, ngakolunye uhlangothi, kuhambisana nokuqala kabusha komjikelezo wakho wokuya esikhathini ngemva kwalesi sikhathi.
Lochia.51: Ukuphuma kwamanzi okuhlobene nokululama kwesibeletho ngemva kokubeletha.
Lochia.53: Ukuqala kabusha komjikelezo wokuya esikhathini, ngesikhathi esihluka phakathi komuntu nomuntu.
Lochia.55: Uma inqubekela phambili ibonakala ingajwayelekile kuwe, noma uma isimo sakho jikelele sesibuyela emuva, kubalulekile ukufuna iseluleko kochwepheshe wezempilo.
Lochia.58: Imfiva noma isimo jikelele esibuyela emuva
Lochia.59: Ukuhamba kwegazi okuzumayo kuba kukhulu kakhulu
Lochia.63: I-lochia ngokuvamile iguquka kancane kancane: ingaba bomvu ekuqaleni, bese iba lula ngaphambi kokuphela. Nokho, ukululama ngakunye kuhlukile.
Lochia.65: I-lochia iyikuphuma kwamanzi okujwayelekile ngemva kokubeletha.
Lochia.67: Ubude bayo nenqubekela phambili yayo kungahluka phakathi komuntu nomuntu.
Lochia.68: Iphunga elingajwayelekile, imfiva, ubuhlungu obukhulu, noma ukopha okuzumayo okukhulu kakhulu kudinga iseluleko sezokwelapha.
Lochia.69: Okuqukethwe okunikeza ulwazi. Lesi sihloko asithathi indawo yeseluleko sezokwelapha noma yokuhlolwa. Uma une-shwa noma uqaphela uphawu olukukhathazayo, funa iseluleko kochwepheshe wezempilo.

MedicalExams.13: Ukukhulelwa ngokuvamile kuhlanganisa ama-ultrasound amathathu amakhulu, owodwa i-trimester ngayinye, ngamunye unenhloso ehlukile.
MedicalExams.14: I-trimester yokuqala: ukunquma isikhathi nokuhlolwa kwe-nuchal translucency
MedicalExams.17: Ukuhlolwa njalo kwegazi kulandelela izimpawu eziningana ezibalulekile ngesikhathi sokukhulelwa:
MedicalExams.18: Amazinga e-iron, ukuhlola ukuthi kungabakhona yini ukuncipha kwegazi
MedicalExams.19: Ukuhlola isifo sikashukela sokukhulelwa, ngokuvamile cishe ku-trimester yesibili
MedicalExams.20: Uhlobo lwegazi nokuhlolwa kwamasosha omzimba angajwayelekile
MedicalExams.21: Ukuhlolwa kwe-serology (i-toxoplasmosis, i-rubella) kuye ngesimo sakho somzimba wokuzivikela
MedicalExams.22: Bhala phansi imibuzo yakho njengoba ifika kuwe, ngaphambi kokuyikhohlwa
MedicalExams.23: Letha incwadi yakho yokulandelela ukukhulelwa ekubonaneni ngakunye
MedicalExams.24: Khuluma ngenoma yiluphi uphawu olusha, ngisho nalapho lubonakala lungabalulekile
MedicalExams.25: Inani eliqondile nohlelo lokuhlolwa kungahluka kuye ngokunakekelwa kwakho, ubungozi bakho, nezindlela zezwe lakho noma zomnikezeli wakho wezempilo.
MedicalExams.27: Ungazinaki ukubhala phansi imibuzo yakho ngaphambi kokubonana ngakunye ukuze ungakhohlwa lutho: akukho mbuzo omncane kakhulu ukuba ubuzwe.

MenopauseHormones.6: Njengoba ukuphela kokuya esikhathini kusondela, ama-hormone akho awami ngokuzumayo: ayashintshashintsha, okuchaza ushintsho emjikelezweni nezinhlobo eziningi zezimpawu ezingaba khona.
MenopauseHormones.9: Kwenzekani ngesikhathi sokudlulela ekupheleni kokuya esikhathini?
MenopauseHormones.21: Ama-hormone amathathu amakhulu ashintsha ngalesi sikhathi sokudlulela, ngalinye linendima ehlukile:
MenopauseHormones.23: Ithinta umjikelezo, isikhumba, amathambo, inhliziyo, futhi ilawula ngokwengxenye ukulala nemizwa.
MenopauseHormones.25: Yakhiwa ngemva kwe-ovulation, inomthelela othulisayo futhi ilungiselela umzimba ukukhulelwa okungenzeka.
MenopauseHormones.27: Ilawulwa ubuchopho, ivusa amaqanda; amazinga ayo ayashintsha njengoba amaqanda ephendula ngendlela ehlukile.
MenopauseHormones.29: Amazinga ama-hormone awehli ngendlela eqondile ngokuphelele ngesikhathi sokudlulela ekupheleni kokuya esikhathini: angashintshashintsha, enyuke futhi ehle, ngaphambi kokuzinza ezingeni eliphansi ngemva kokuphela kokuya esikhathini.
MenopauseHormones.30: Amaqanda aphendula kancane kancane ngokungahleleki kakhulu emasignalini ama-hormone athunyelwa ubuchopho. Yilokhu okwenza imijikelezo ingahleleki futhi kuchaza ukuthi kungani izimpawu zingashintsha inyanga ngenyanga.
MenopauseHormones.32: Kungenzeka ngokuphelele ukuba nezimpawu ezibonakalayo inyanga eyodwa, bese zingabikho cishe inyanga elandelayo. Lokhu akungajwayelekile: kubonisa nje ukushintshashintsha kwama-hormone kwalesi sikhathi.
MenopauseHormones.40: Lezi zimpawu zingaba nezimbangela eziningana: azihlali zihlobene nama-hormone, futhi ubukhulu bazo buhluka kakhulu phakathi komuntu nomuntu.
MenopauseHormones.41: I-progesterone yakhiwa kuphela ngemva kwe-ovulation. Kodwa ngesikhathi sokudlulela ekupheleni kokuya esikhathini, i-ovulation ngokwayo iba ngahleleki kakhulu — okwenza ukukhiqizwa kwayo kube nzima ukukubikezela.
MenopauseHormones.42: Lokhu kungahleleki kuchaza ngokwengxenye izinguquko ezibonwa emjikelezweni: ubude obuguqukayo, izikhathi ezinye ezinzima noma ezilula kunangaphambilini.
MenopauseHormones.43: Ngaphandle kokushintshashintsha kwama-hormone, ezinye izinto eziningana ziyabamba iqhaza: ikhwalithi yokulala, amazinga okucindezeleka, indlela yokuphila, nokuhlukana okuthile komuntu ngamunye.
MenopauseHormones.54: Lolu hlu lungolwazi kuphela: akusona isiko. Umuntu ngamunye uhlangabezana nokuhlangana okuhlukile kwalezi zinguquko.
MenopauseHormones.55: Ukubila ebusuku kungaphazamisa ukulala, okuholela ekukhathaleni nasebunzimeni bokugxila ngosuku olulandelayo — iphethini evamile ngalesi sikhathi.
MenopauseHormones.57: Igumbi lokulala elipholile, izingubo ezilula, nomkhuba ozinzile wasebusuku kungasiza ukunciphisa lokhu kuvuka.
MenopauseHormones.58: Ukushintshashintsha kwama-hormone kungahambisana noshintsho lwemizwa, ngaphandle kokuba yisona sizathu sodwa: ukulala, ukucindezeleka, ushintsho lwempilo, nezimpawu zomzimba nakho kubamba iqhaza.
MenopauseHormones.60: Ukuzizwa unemizwa eminingi ngalesi sikhathi akusho ukuthi kukhona okungalungile: kuwulwazi olujwayelekile okungaba nezimbangela eziningana ngesikhathi esisodwa.
MenopauseHormones.61: Amazinga ama-hormone angahluka kakhulu usuku nosuku ngesikhathi sokudlulela ekupheleni kokuya esikhathini. Ngakho ukuhlolwa okukodwa akunikezi njalo isithombe esigcwele sesimo.
MenopauseHormones.63: Ukuhlolwa kwezokwelapha kuncike kakhulu eminyakeni yakho, ezimpawini zakho, nasemlandweni womjikelezo wakho — hhayi nje inombolo eyodwa.
MenopauseHormones.64: Ukubhala lokho okuhlangabezana nakho inyanga ngenyanga kukusiza ubone amaphethini akho siqu kunokuzaqhathanisa nabanye:
MenopauseHormones.73: Ukulandelela umjikelezo wakho ku-AWA kungakusiza ubone amaphethini akho siqu ezinyangeni, ngaphandle komzamo owengeziwe.
MenopauseHormones.74: Izimo eziningi zalezi zidinga ukubonana okujwayelekile, ngejubane lakho:
MenopauseHormones.76: Izimpawu ezithinta kakhulu impilo yakho yansuku zonke
MenopauseHormones.82: Ukukhathazeka okuhlobene nokomisa kwesithandwa noma impilo yakho yobulili
MenopauseHormones.84: Ukopha okukhulu kakhulu noma okungajwayelekile, ngakolunye uhlangothi, kufanele kubikwe kochwepheshe wezempilo masinyane.
MenopauseHormones.85: Kuye ngesimo, uchwepheshe angaphakamisa izinketho ezahlukene:
MenopauseHormones.89: Ezinye izinketho zingaqondisa izimpawu ezithile, kuye ngesimo.
MenopauseHormones.91: Kukhulunywa ngakho nodokotela uma kulingana nesimo sakho nezidingo zakho.
MenopauseHormones.92: Lezi zinqumo ziyahlala zingezomuntu ngamunye: zincike emlandweni wakho, ezimpawini zakho, ezingozini, nasezintandweni zakho siqu.
MenopauseHormones.93: Ushintsho lwama-hormone luyingxenye ebalulekile yokudlulela ekupheleni kokuya esikhathini.
MenopauseHormones.94: Amazinga ama-hormone angashintshashintsha kakhulu ngesikhathi sokudlulela ekupheleni kokuya esikhathini, ngaphandle kokwehla okuqondile ngokuphelele.
MenopauseHormones.95: Izimpawu zihluka kakhulu phakathi komuntu nomuntu, nenyanga ngenyanga.
MenopauseHormones.96: Ukulandelela izimpawu zakho kungakusiza ubone amaphethini akho siqu kangcono.
MenopauseHormones.97: Uchwepheshe wezempilo angakweseka uma izimpawu ziba nzima ukuzilawula.
MenopauseHormones.98: Okuqukethwe okunikeza ulwazi. Lesi sihloko asithathi indawo yeseluleko sezokwelapha esikhethekile kuwe. Uma une-shwa, funa isiqondiso kochwepheshe wezempilo.
MenopauseHormones.99: Ama-hormone ngesikhathi sokuphela kokuya esikhathini — AWA

MenopauseTransition.6: Yini eshintsha kancane kancane, iminyaka ngaphambi kokuthi izikhathi ziphele, nokuthi ungasondela kanjani kulesi sigaba ngokucacile kakhulu.
MenopauseTransition.8: Ukudlulela ekupheleni kokuya esikhathini nokuphela kokuya esikhathini: izincazelo
MenopauseTransition.17: 1. Ukudlulela ekupheleni kokuya esikhathini nokuphela kokuya esikhathini: izincazelo
MenopauseTransition.18: Ukudlulela ekupheleni kokuya esikhathini kubhekisela esikhathini sokudlulela kwama-hormone esandulela ukuphela kokuya esikhathini: kungaqala iminyaka eminingana ngaphambili, ngokuvamile kusukela eminyakeni yamashumi amane, kanti amazinga e-estrogen ashintshashintsha ngokungahleleki.
MenopauseTransition.19: Ukuphela kokuya esikhathini, ngakolunye uhlangothi, kuyisikhathi esithile: kuqinisekiswa ngemva kwezinyanga eziyi-12 ezilandelanayo ngaphandle kokuya esikhathini, ngaphandle kwenye imbangela. EFrance, kwenzeka ngokwesilinganiso cishe eminyakeni engu-51, nakuba leli gama lihluka ngokwemvelo phakathi kwabesifazane.
MenopauseTransition.21: Wonke owesifazane uhlangabezana nalokhu kudlulela ngendlela ehlukile, kokubili ngobude nangobukhulu bezimpawu. Ukukhuluma ngakho ngokukhululekile kukusiza ukulungiselela kangcono.
MenopauseTransition.23: Esinye sezimpawu zokuqala zokudlulela ekupheleni kokuya esikhathini kuvame ukuba ushintsho esigqini somjikelezo: imijikelezo ingaba mifushane, mide, ihlukane kakhulu, noma ibe nokuhamba okuhlukile inyanga ngenyanga.
MenopauseTransition.25: Ukopha okukhulu kakhulu, ukopha okwenzeka kusondelene kakhulu, noma ukopha okwenzeka ngemva konyaka ungayi esikhathini kudinga iseluleko sezokwelapha, njengoba lezi zingathathwa njengezimpawu ezijwayelekile zokudlulela.
MenopauseTransition.27: Ukwehla nokushintshashintsha kwe-estrogen ne-progesterone kungaphazamisa ukulala (ukulala ubuthongo, ukuvuka ebusuku) futhi kungahambisana nokucasuka, ukukhathazeka, noma ushintsho lwemizwa olungajwayelekile.
MenopauseTransition.28: Lezi zinguquko zinencazelo yangempela yebhayoloji: aziboniseli ukuntula amandla okuzimisela noma inkinga yengqondo ehlukile.
MenopauseTransition.30: Ukwehla kwe-estrogen kungaholela ekomisweni kwesithandwa, kwesinye isikhathi kubangele ukungakhululeki noma ubuhlungu ngesikhathi sokuzalana. Isifiso naso singashintsha, sikhuphuke noma sehle, kuye ngowesifazane.
MenopauseTransition.32: Izixazululo ezilula zikhona (ama-lubricant, izinto zokumanzisa isithandwa, ukwelashwa kwendawo): ukukhuluma nochwepheshe wezempilo kungakusiza uthole isixazululo esifanele, ngaphandle kwenhloni.
MenopauseTransition.34: Ukusebenza komzimba kungehla kancane ngalesi sikhathi, futhi ukusatshalaliswa kwamafutha kuvame ukuya esiswini. Lezi zinguquko ziyajwayelekile futhi azincikile kuphela emandleni okuzimisela.
MenopauseTransition.36: Ukuphela kokuya esikhathini "kwenzeka kanyekanye" — empeleni, kunesandulelwa iminyaka eminingana yokudlulela (ukudlulela ekupheleni kokuya esikhathini)
MenopauseTransition.37: Zonke izimpawu zinzima kubo bonke — ubukhulu bazo buhluka kakhulu phakathi kwabesifazane
MenopauseTransition.38: Akukho okungenziwa — izixazululo eziningi, ezinama-hormone noma ezingenawo, zikhona ukunciphisa izimpawu ezikhathazayo
MenopauseTransition.39: Impilo yobuhlobo iyaphela — iyashintsha, kodwa ihlala ingenzeka ngokuphelele futhi iyanelisa ngezilungiso ezifanele
MenopauseTransition.41: Iningi lezinguquko ezichazwe lapha ziyizimpawu ezijwayelekile zokudlulela. Nokho, ezinye izimpawu zidinga ukunakekelwa ngokwezokwelapha masinyane.
MenopauseTransition.43: Ukopha ngemva kokuqinisekiswa kokuphela kokuya esikhathini, ubuhlungu be-pelvis obungajwayelekile, izimpawu eziphazamisa kakhulu impilo yansuku zonke, noma noma yikuphi ukungabaza okuqhubekayo.
MenopauseTransition.51: Ukudlulela ekupheleni kokuya esikhathini nokuphela kokuya esikhathini kuyizigaba zemvelo, akusona isifo. Izixazululo eziningi zikhona zokukusiza udlule kulokhu kudlulela ngokukhululeka kakhulu: uchwepheshe wezempilo uhlala eyisisetshenziswa esingcono kakhulu sokuzivumelanisa nesimo sakho.
MenopauseTransition.52: Ukuqonda ukudlulela ekupheleni kokuya esikhathini — AWA

MenopauseTreatments.6: Ukwelashwa ngokuthatha indawo yama-hormone nezinye izindlela ezingenawo ama-hormone, ukukusiza ulungiselele ingxoxo nodokotela wakho.
MenopauseTreatments.8: Ukwelashwa ngokuthatha indawo yama-hormone ekupheleni kokuya esikhathini
MenopauseTreatments.13: Ukwelashwa ngokuthatha indawo yama-hormone ekupheleni kokuya esikhathini (HRT) kunxephezela ukwehla kwe-estrogen futhi kungakhulula izimpawu ezikhathaza kakhulu, njengokushisa okuphumayo, izinkinga zokulala, noma ukomisa kwesithandwa.
MenopauseTreatments.14: I-HRT ingasiza nokuvikela ukuminyana kwamathambo. Nokho, ayilungele wonke amacala: umlando siqu wezimo ezithile (isifo senhliziyo nemithambo yegazi, ezinye izimila ezixhomekeke kuma-hormone) ungase uyivimbele ukusetshenziswa.
MenopauseTreatments.16: Ukulingana kwezinzuzo nobungozi be-HRT kuncike eminyakeni yakho, ekutheni iqala nini uma kuqhathaniswa nokuphela kokuya esikhathini, nasemlandweni wakho siqu wezokwelapha: kudingeka ukuhlolwa kwezokwelapha okukhethekile ngaphambi kwanoma yisiphi isinqumo.
MenopauseTreatments.17: Uma i-HRT ingafunwa noma ingalungile, ezinye izinketho zikhona zokusiza ukukhulula izimpawu:
MenopauseTreatments.19: Imithi yamakhambi, ngaphansi kokuqondiswa uchwepheshe wezempilo
MenopauseTreatments.21: Ama-lubricant nezinto zokumanzisa isithandwa ukomisa kwezindawo zangasese
MenopauseTreatments.23: Ngisho nemithi yamakhambi ifanele iseluleko somuntu onolwazi: “okwemvelo” akusho “ngaphandle kokuhlangana okungase kube khona” nezinye izindlela zokwelapha.
MenopauseTreatments.24: Ukulungiselela amaphuzu ambalwa ngaphambi kokubonana kukusiza usebenzise kahle ingxoxo:
MenopauseTreatments.25: Izimpawu zakho ezikhathaza kakhulu zansuku zonke
MenopauseTreatments.27: Izintandokazi zakho (nama-hormone noma cha, isikhathi osicabangayo)
MenopauseTreatments.28: Imibuzo yakho nokukhathazeka kwakho — ungazinaki ukuyibuza
MenopauseTreatments.30: Kungaba nama-hormone noma cha, akukho ukwelashwa okuhambelana nabo bonke: okulungele wena kuncike esimweni sakho siqu, esihlolwa nochwepheshe wezempilo.

MenstruationPurity.6: Ukuqonda ubuhlobo phakathi komjikelezo nesimo sokuhlanzeka kwenkolo, ukusondela kulesi sikhathi ngokucacile kakhulu.
MenstruationPurity.8: Lokhu okuqukethwe kungokwemfundo kuphela. Imibuzo yenkolo kufanele iqinisekiswe izazi ezifanelekile. I-AWA ayikhiphi ama-fatwa noma izinqumo zenkolo ezikhethekile.
MenstruationPurity.10: Ukuqonda ukuthi ukuhlanzeka kwenkolo kusho ukuthini
MenstruationPurity.12: Ngemva kokuya esikhathini: ukubona ukubuyela ekuhlanzekeni
MenstruationPurity.16: Esikweni lobuSulumane, ukuhlanzeka kwenkolo (i-tahara) kubhekisela esimweni esidingekayo ukwenza izenzo ezithile zokukhonza, njengokukhuleka. Akubhekiseli enhlanzekweni ngomqondo wansuku zonke, kodwa esimweni esithile esaziwa yi-fiqh, esishintsha ngokwezigaba zomjikelezo wowesifazane.
MenstruationPurity.17: Ngesikhathi sokuya esikhathini, owesifazane ukhululwa ezenzweni ezithile zokukhonza, ikakhulukazi ukukhuleka nokuzila kwe-Ramadan, okungenziwa kamuva. Lokhu kukhululwa kwaziwa njengokuvuselela, hhayi njengesijeziso.
MenstruationPurity.20: Ukulalela noma ukufunda okuqukethwe kwemfundo nokomoya
MenstruationPurity.24: Ezinye izinto (njengokufunda i-Qur'an ngqo noma ukungena emsamo) zingahluka kuye ngesikole somthetho wenkolo; kungcono ukubheka umbono owujwayele ukuwulandela noma ukubuza isazi esifanelekile kulezi zimo ezithile.
MenstruationPurity.25: Ukuphela kokuya esikhathini kukhombisa ukubuyela kancane kancane esimweni sokuhlanzeka kwenkolo. Ngokwezinto zomzimba, lokhu kuhambisana nokumiswa kokopha, uphawu ezinye izikole zezazi ezingalichaza ngokuhluka okuncane.
MenstruationPurity.27: Ukuqonda izigaba zomjikelezo kukusiza ukhombe kangcono isikhathi lapho ukuya esikhathini kuphela ngempela.
MenstruationPurity.28: Uma lolu phawu selubonwe, i-ghusl (ukugeza okukhulu) ivumela ukubuyela ekuhlanzekeni kwenkolo nokuqhubeka nezenzo zokukhonza ezazimisiwe.
MenstruationPurity.29: I-Ghusl iwukugeza okukhulu kwenkolo okubandakanya ukugeza umzimba wonke ngenhloso yokuzihlanza. Ikhombisa ukuphela kokukhululwa futhi ivumela ukukhuleka ukuqhubeka ngokujwayelekile, ngaphandle kokudingeka ukuthi kuhlengwe ukukhuleka okuphuthelwe ngesikhathi sokuya esikhathini.
MenstruationPurity.31: Indlela eqondile i-ghusl enziwa ngayo ingahluka kancane kuye ngesikole somthetho wenkolo olandelwayo.
MenstruationPurity.33: Uma ungazi izinyathelo eziqondile ezilandelwa esikoleni sakho, umuntu omethembayo noma isazi esifanelekile uzokwazi ukukuchazela kahle.
MenstruationPurity.34: Kuvamile ukuzizwa ungabaza ukuthi ukuya esikhathini kuphele ngempela, ikakhulukazi uma ukopha kuncipha kancane kancane kunokuma ngokuzumayo.
MenstruationPurity.36: Bheka ukungabikho okuphelele kokopha, hhayi nje ukwehla
MenstruationPurity.37: Vumela isikhathi esanele sidlule ngaphambi kokuphetha ukuthi ukuya esikhathini kuphelile
MenstruationPurity.38: Thembela ekubhekeni okucacile kunokuba uthembele emizweni nje
MenstruationPurity.39: Cabangela isigqi sakho esijwayelekile, esingahluka emjikelezweni nomjikelezo
MenstruationPurity.41: Ezimweni zokopha okuqhubeka isikhathi eside noma okungahleleki, noma ukungabaza okuqhubekayo, lezi zimo zifanele ukuxoxwa nesazi esifanelekile, esingakuhola ngokwesimo sakho siqu. Lokhu okuqukethwe kuhlala kunikeza ulwazi futhi akuthathi indawo yesiqondiso senkolo esikhethekile.
MenstruationPurity.43: Lezi zikhombisi ziyizikhumbuzo zemfundo ezijwayelekile. Isimo ngasinye singaba nezici zaso: uma une-shwa, ingxoxo nesazi esifanelekile iqhubeka iyisisetshenziswa esingcono kakhulu sempendulo elungele isimo sakho.

MiscarriageFertility.6: Ukuthi ucabange nini nokuthi ucabange kanjani ngokuzama futhi, ngejubane lakho nangokuzethemba okugcwele.
MiscarriageFertility.13: Ukuzala ngokuvamile kubuya ngokushesha emjikelezweni olandela ukuphuphuma kwesisu kwangaphambili. I-ovulation ingenzeka ngisho nangaphambi kokuthi isikhathi sakho sibonakale sibuya.
MiscarriageFertility.15: Kuye ngesigaba sokulahlekelwa, isikhathi sokululama komzimba singahluka kancane kusukela esimweni kuya kwesinye.
MiscarriageFertility.16: Ochwepheshe abaningi bacabanga ukuthi akudingeki ukulinda imijikelezo eminingana ngaphambi kokuzama futhi, ngaphandle kokuthi udokotela wakho noma umbelethisi akweluleke ngenye indlela.
MiscarriageFertility.18: Ukuzala kuvame ukubuya ngokushesha, kusukela emjikelezweni olandelayo.
MiscarriageFertility.20: Isikhathi esihamba isikhathi eside kancane sokululama singanconywa yithimba lezokwelapha.
MiscarriageFertility.21: Ukuzizwa ulungele, ngokomzimba nangokwemizwa, kuhlala kuyisiholi esibaluleke kakhulu — ngaphezu kakhulu kunanoma yisiphi isikhathi sethiyori.
MiscarriageFertility.23: Ukuzizwa ulungele ngaphakathi kubaluleke njengokululama komzimba.
MiscarriageFertility.25: Umjikelezo ohlelekile nomuzwa wokuphila kahle kuyizikhombisi ezinhle.
MiscarriageFertility.27: Ukukhuluma ngakho nozakwenu kungakusiza niqhubeke ngejubane elifanayo.
MiscarriageFertility.28: Ngaphambi kokuzama futhi, ukubonana nodokotela kungakusiza uqhubeke ngokuthula kwengqondo okukhulu:
MiscarriageFertility.34: Ukunakekelwa kokulandelela kungakweseka ngokuthula njengoba uzama futhi.
MiscarriageFertility.36: Ukuphuphuma kwesisu okukodwa ngokuvamile akukhombisi inkinga yokuzala. Ithimba lakho lezokwelapha lihlala lilungele kakhulu ukuphendula imibuzo yakho siqu.
MiscarriageFertility.37: Ukuzala ngokuvamile kubuya ngokushesha emjikelezweni olandela ukuphuphuma kwesisu kwangaphambili.
MiscarriageFertility.38: Ochwepheshe abaningi bacabanga ukuthi akudingeki ukulinda imijikelezo eminingana, ngaphandle uma kululeke ngenye indlela.
MiscarriageFertility.39: Ukuzizwa ulungele, ngokomzimba nangokwemizwa, kuhlala kuyisiholi esibaluleke kakhulu.
MiscarriageFertility.40: Ukulandelela kwezokwelapha kungakweseka futhi kukuqinisekise ngaphambi kokuzama futhi.
MiscarriageFertility.41: Okuqukethwe okunikeza ulwazi. Lesi sihloko asithathi indawo yeseluleko sezokwelapha esikhethekile kuwe. Udokotela wakho noma umbelethisi uhlala eyisethenjwa ngesimo sakho.
MiscarriageFertility.42: Ukuzala nokuzama futhi ngemva kokulahlekelwa — AWA

MiscarriageGrief.6: Akukho ndlela efanele yokudlula kulokhu. Wonke umuntu udlula ngendlela yakhe, ngejubane lakhe.
MiscarriageGrief.14: Ukudabuka, ulaka, noma umuzwa wokuntuleka kuyimiphumela ejwayelekile kulokhu kulahlekelwa, noma ngabe sasiyisiphi isigaba sokukhulelwa. Lokho okuzwayo kufanele kuvunywe.
MiscarriageGrief.16: Akukho ndlela efanele noma engalungile yokudlula kulokhu. Yonke imizwa oyizwayo iyasebenza.
MiscarriageGrief.17: Ungazwa eyodwa noma eminingi yalezi, kwesinye isikhathi zonke kanyekanye:
MiscarriageGrief.19: Usizi olungeza lubuye, kwesinye isikhathi ngokungalindelekile.
MiscarriageGrief.21: Kuwe, esimweni, noma emuzweni wokungabi nabulungisa — futhi lokho akukho okufanele ukukhathazele.
MiscarriageGrief.23: Umuzwa wokuntuleka noma ukudideka ngalokho okuqhamuke kwenzeka.
MiscarriageGrief.24: Ukuzinika isikhathi, ngaphandle kwengcindezi noma ukuqhathanisa, kuyingxenye ebalulekile yokuphola.
MiscarriageGrief.26: Ngaphandle kwengcindezi noma umkhawulo wokuthi “uzizwe kangcono.”
MiscarriageGrief.28: Isililo ngasinye sihlukile; akukho ndlela efanele yokudlula kuso.
MiscarriageGrief.30: Ukubhala noma ukukhuluma ngalokho okuzwayo kungasiza ukukhulula isisindo semizwa yakho.
MiscarriageGrief.31: Ukukhuluma nomuntu osondelene nawe, iqembu losekelo, noma uchwepheshe kungasiza ukukhulula lesi sisindo. Nansi indlela abathandekayo abangasiza ngayo:
MiscarriageGrief.32: Indlela umuntu othandekayo angaphana ngayo isekelo
MiscarriageGrief.33: Lalela ngaphandle kokwahlulela, ngisho nangaphandle kwamazwi aphelele
MiscarriageGrief.34: Gweme ukwehlisa ulwazi (“akuzange kube yinto enkulu,” “ungazama futhi”)
MiscarriageGrief.35: Nikeza ukuba khona kwakho kunokunikeza izixazululo
MiscarriageGrief.37: Ezinye izimpawu zingabonisa ukuthi isekelo lochwepheshe lingaba usizo:
MiscarriageGrief.39: Ukudabuka kuhlala isikhathi eside futhi kuyanda kunokuba kuncipha
MiscarriageGrief.42: Kuvela imicabango eshaya noma ukucindezeleka okukhulu
MiscarriageGrief.44: Umbelethisi, udokotela, usaziwayo wezengqondo, noma iqembu losekelo lingakulalela futhi likweseke, ngaphandle kokwahlulela.
MiscarriageGrief.46: Ukucela usizo akusona uphawu lobuthakathaka — kuyindlela yokuzinakekela ngalesi sikhathi.
MiscarriageGrief.47: Akukho ndlela efanele noma engalungile yokudlula kulolu lwazi.
MiscarriageGrief.48: Ukudabuka, ulaka, noma umuzwa wokuntuleka kuyimiphumela ejwayelekile.
MiscarriageGrief.49: Ukuzinika isikhathi, ngaphandle kwengcindezi noma ukuqhathanisa, kuyingxenye yokuphola.
MiscarriageGrief.50: Ukukhuluma nomuntu osondelene nawe, iqembu losekelo, noma uchwepheshe kungasiza ukukhulula lesi sisindo.
MiscarriageGrief.51: Okuqukethwe okunikeza ulwazi. Lesi sihloko asithathi indawo yeseluleko sochwepheshe. Uma udlula esikhathini esinzima, ungazinaki ukukhuluma nochwepheshe wezempilo.
